rpc_results.uq_grid_code_template_name: Polish IRiESP Type D U-Q @ 400 kV
rpc_results.pcc_q_convention: Red curves: net reactive power at the selected PCC bus after power flow (res_bus.q_mvar), including all shunts, lines, transformers, and injections at that bus. Sign for the chart: if PCC is the External Grid bus, use res_bus.q_mvar as plotted; if PCC is another bus, use −res_bus.q_mvar so +Q matches overexcited / −Q underexcited relative to the usual grid-connection frame. Blue curves are grid-code PCC requirements.
